answer: Require every rewarded agent to carry a sybil-liability policy bought from independent underwriters who post their own capital and pay a bounty pool if the insured identity is later proven a clone. Like surveyors probing karst before pouring a foundation, underwriters price risk by probing history: a hollow account with no outside counterparties pays a steep premium, while a bridge of verified work with unrelated peers cheapens it. A farm of clones must buy many costly policies, and underwriters who misprice them lose their stake.
